title: AI Powered Graphic Designing – Foundation
subtitle: 3 months · 12 weeks · Foundation · 4 days a week, 2 hours a day
summary: Hands-on graphic designing for print and digital media: design principles, CorelDRAW, Urdu designing in InPage, Canva for social media and AI tools for creative ideas, ending with a mini portfolio and a final practical project.
expert: At the end you can design logos, business cards, flyers, posters, certificates, Urdu layouts and social media posts, prepare them for print or digital use, and show them in a basic portfolio.

benchmarks.title: Design principles
benchmarks.detail: Understand and apply the elements and principles of graphic design: colour theory, typography, layout and visual hierarchy.

benchmarks.title: CorelDRAW
benchmarks.detail: Use CorelDRAW for vector design, print media and branding projects.

benchmarks.title: Urdu designing
benchmarks.detail: Create Urdu layouts in InPage for notices, advertisements, invitation cards, certificates and publications.

benchmarks.title: Digital design
benchmarks.detail: Use Canva for social media posts, covers, stories, campaigns and presentations.

benchmarks.title: Print and digital output
benchmarks.detail: Prepare designs to the size and file format that print and digital media need (PDF, JPG, PNG).

benchmarks.title: AI tools
benchmarks.detail: Use ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Canva AI for creative ideas and content, responsibly.

benchmarks.title: Portfolio
benchmarks.detail: Develop a basic portfolio and complete a practical final project.
